**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Archdeacon](../persons.html#888)[^1]
At last I return all the precious letters you lent me.[^2] I ought to have done so sooner
I have not been able to use many as they went so much on the same ground as the journal letters.

With many thanks

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^2]: The Rev.

John Frederick Lloyd (1810-1875) was a fellow of St John\'s College, Auckland, 1849-1853, vicar of St Paul\'s, Auckland, 1853-1865 and archdeacon of Waitemata, 1865-1870.

Owing to ill health he returned to England in 1870 where he became rector of Kirk-lreton, Wirksworth. CMY is thanking him for help with her [Life of John Coleridge Patteson](../books.html#102).
